datalogic-quickscan-qm-2130.title: Datalogic QuickScan 1D QM 2130
datalogic-quickscan-qm-2130.description: Datalogic QuickScan QM2130 is a mobile barcode reader with a radio transmission. The technology used for the transmission of scanned data to the communication base and implicitly to the computer is called STAR. It is a technology patented by Datalogic ADC that operates in the 433MHz frequency band. The main advantages in using STAR technology compared to traditional Bluetooth technology are the longer transmission distance (10-18 meters), the possibility of two-way communication (simultaneously transmits and receives information), and the exclusivity of the frequency. When we mention the exclusivity of the frequency we refer to the fact that in the 433MHz STAR band only Datalogic mobile devices work - you do not interfere with other devices equipped with Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, you do not interfere with mice and wireless keyboards, automatic gates or any other device which transmits through radio waves. QM2130 is a linear barcode imager. This is due to the fact that it can easily read linear (1D) barcodes even if they are less legible, partially damaged, or dirty. The failure rate of linear imager barcode readers is very low because there are no mirrors and no moving components inside the scanner. The Batch function with which Datalogic QuickScan Mobile 2130 is equipped allows it to read barcodes even after leaving the range of the cradle (communication base). The memory allows it to store up to 4,000 barcodes and download them automatically when it re-enters the communication range. Green-Spot technology signals the successful reading of a green barcode. In this way, the reader can be used successfully in very noisy working environments where the audible warning is not heard or in working environments where silence is an essential detail.

A specially designed stand has been created for the QW2100 imager which is light in weight, collapsible to use as a holder instead of a stand, and also has a ‘tiltable head’ for various angle settings. nvr-uniview-unicorn.title: NVR Uniview Unicorn
nvr-uniview-unicorn.description: Uniview Unicorn is a high‑performance Network Video Recorder (NVR) designed for large‑scale video surveillance systems. It supports up to 1000 devices or 2000 channels, with powerful storage and decoding capabilities. Featuring Linux‑based stability, support for standard ONVIF cameras, and access via web browsers or mobile apps (iOS/Android), Unicorn provides unified management of NVRs, IP cameras, decoders, and other devices. With room for up to 16 SATA hard drives (expandable with disk enclosures) and compatibility with advanced video wall, playback, and alarm plan functions, it’s ideal for enterprise, industrial, and public security environments.

nvr-uniview-nvr301-08e.title: NVR Uniview NVR301-08E
nvr-uniview-nvr301-08e.description:
The Uniview NVR301-08E is a compact and reliable network video recorder designed to record up to 8 IP cameras. It features HDMI output (3840×2160) and VGA output, providing high-quality video for monitoring.

The recorder supports IP cameras with resolutions up to 8 MP and modern compression formats H.265 and H.264, saving storage space without compromising video quality. It allows installation of one SATA hard drive up to 6 TB for video storage.

The device is fully compatible with third-party cameras via ONVIF and supports network protocols P2P, UPnP, NTP, DHCP, and PPPoE for easy connection and integration. For remote monitoring, a mobile app is available, enabling live video viewing from any device.

nvr-uniview-nvr301-16-p8.title: NVR Uniview NVR301-16-P8
nvr-uniview-nvr301-16-p8.description:
NVR301-16-P8 is a 16-channel network video recorder with a built-in 8-port HPoE switch and a total power budget of 108 W. The device supports IP cameras with a resolution of up to 8 MP.

The maximum incoming bitrate of 80 Mbps allows recording and playback in real-time (25 fps) on each of the 16 channels.

For video storage, the recorder is equipped with a bay for installing one SATA HDD up to 6 TB.

Support for H.265 / H.264 compression codecs ensures high image clarity, improved color reproduction, and reduced storage usage.

Live video and recorded footage can be viewed via the VGA video output when connected to a high-resolution monitor. Connecting a widescreen TV or LCD monitor via HDMI allows viewing recordings in multi-screen mode.

The presence of audio input and output enables two-way audio communication through a single audio channel.

Support for the ONVIF protocol ensures compatibility with IP cameras from various manufacturers.

P2P technology allows remote access to the surveillance system.

nvr-uniview-nvr301-04e.title: NVR Uniview NVR301-04E
nvr-uniview-nvr301-04e.description:
The Uniview NVR301-04E is a reliable 4-channel network video recorder designed for small and medium-sized surveillance systems. It supports modern video compression formats Ultra 265, H.265, and H.264, ensuring high-quality recordings while optimizing storage space.

The recorder supports up to 4 IP cameras and is compatible with third-party cameras via ONVIF (Profile S, G, T). It features HDMI and VGA outputs up to 1080P, providing clear and stable video monitoring.

For storage, the device allows installation of 1 SATA hard drive up to 10 TB. ANR technology ensures recording reliability during network interruptions, and cloud upgrade support simplifies system maintenance and updates.

nvr-uniview-nvr301-08-p8.title: NVR Uniview NVR301-08-P8
nvr-uniview-nvr301-08-p8.description:
The Uniview NVR301-08-P8 is a reliable and easy-to-install network video recorder designed for video surveillance systems. The device supports up to 8 IP cameras and features 8 independent PoE ports, allowing cameras to be powered directly through the network cable.

With Plug & Play technology, cameras are automatically detected and configured, making system installation quick and simple. Support for modern compression formats Ultra 265, H.265, and H.264 helps reduce storage usage while maintaining high video quality.

The recorder is compatible with third-party IP cameras thanks to ONVIF support (Profile S, G, T). It also provides HDMI and VGA outputs for monitor connection, which can work simultaneously.

nvr-uniview-nvr301-16e.title: NVR Uniview NVR301-16E
nvr-uniview-nvr301-16e.description:
Uniview NVR301-16E — 16-Channel Network Video Recorder

The Uniview NVR301-16E is a reliable network video recorder designed for video surveillance systems with up to 16 IP cameras. It supports modern video compression formats including Ultra 265, H.265 and H.264, helping to reduce storage usage while maintaining high video quality.

With ONVIF compatibility (Profile S, G, T), the recorder can work with third-party IP cameras from various manufacturers. HDMI and VGA outputs allow easy connection to monitors with resolutions up to 1080P.

The ANR (Automatic Network Replenishment) technology improves storage reliability. If the network connection is interrupted, the camera continues recording to its memory card and automatically transfers the data to the NVR once the connection is restored.

nvr-uniview-nvr302-16e-b1.title: NVR Uniview NVR302-16E-B1
nvr-uniview-nvr302-16e-b1.description:
Professional 16-Channel Network Video Recorder Uniview NVR302-16E-B

The Uniview NVR302-16E-B is a professional 16-channel network video recorder that allows simultaneous video viewing by up to 128 users. The device supports connection of up to 16 IP cameras with resolutions of up to 12 megapixels.

The recorder features cloud upgrade support, enabling easy and convenient system updates.

The device supports high-quality video recording with a resolution of 12 MP (4000 × 3000 pixels) via the HDMI output, and 1920 × 1080 pixels when using the VGA output. The power consumption of the unit is 20 W, excluding the power usage of installed hard drives.

The recorder supports installation of two SATA hard drives, each with a capacity of up to 8 TB. It also includes 3 USB ports:

  • 1 × USB 2.0 on the front panel
  • 2 ports on the rear panel: 1 × USB 2.0 and 1 × USB 3.0

nvr-uniview-nvr302-16e-p16-b.title: NVR Uniview NVR302-16E-P16-B

nvr-uniview-nvr304-32e-b.title: NVR Uniview NVR304-32E-B

contor-flux-de-vizitatori-stereo-3d.title: RCount visitor counter
contor-flux-de-vizitatori-stereo-3d.description:
The RCount visitor counter was designed for accurate visitor counting in retail stores and shopping malls, with dense passing traffic, and in places with unstable lighting. The counting of visitors under the counter is carried out according to the determination of the head of each passing person so that it is possible to accurately count. The main feature of the RCount is the ability to exclude shadows, sun glare, children, grocery carts, etc. from the count.

How does it work:

  • Two graphical sensors send data to the counter's processor, which creates a 3D model of object movement that allows the visitor's position and size to be detected with high accuracy.
  • The processor compares the obtained two images and finds the matching parts in them; based on the collected data, it calculates and recreates a 3D model of the space. Then, using the built-in software, the processor detects visitors who have passed through the counting point.
  • The collected data is saved by the processor to FLASH memory and then transferred via the network to the data processing system.

Technical specifications:

  • Installation height 2.4-6 meters
  • Automatic adjustment to external light factors - darkness, sunlight, brightness
  • Super-dense traffic counting
  • Filtration by human height
  • High visitor counting accuracy
  • Cooling without fan

  • Real-time knowledge of the number of visitors
  • Discover the peak hours with the highest traffic and the highest sales opportunities
  • Possibility to perform comparative analyzes between monitored locations on traffic data, sales, and campaigns
  • Analyzes for marketing reports: the comparative trend by years
  • You can choose reports by the hour, day, week, month, year, or custom selections of periods
  • Maximize sales by monitoring your conversion rate

The supporting element for cable suspension is made of phosphate steel wire with a diameter of 1.0 mm. The minimum bending radius of such a cable is much smaller than usual - up to 10 - 30 mm.

Purpose:

It is designed to use in FTTH networks 2 fibers. Designed for laying inside buildings, in risers, basements, pipelines, attics, offices, and apartments, as well as for passing between houses and poles (self-supporting structure). Easily attached to any flat surface, simple and convenient for cutting and installation. Cables with reduced bending loss can be run inside multi-family buildings or offices in cramped conditions. On skirting boards, jambs, at sharp turns of the route, when installing cables using brackets.

blocator-de-parcare-inteligent-pshare-n0.title: Smart Parking Lock - Rparking Lock
blocator-de-parcare-inteligent-pshare-n0.description:
Rparking Lock is a smart parking lock equipped with a wired connection and vehicle monitoring function, specially developed for electric vehicle charging stations. In locations where trenches and wiring can be easily installed, the lock can be connected directly to the charging station via the RS485 interface, thus becoming an integrated extension of it.

The device is ideal for public parking lots, underground garages, or other controlled areas where dedicated parking space protection is required. Control is done via a mobile app: when the vehicle owner connects, the lock automatically lowers to allow access.

After the vehicle is fully charged or when the driver wishes to leave the parking spot, the lock automatically rises and prevents unauthorized occupation by other vehicles. This ensures efficient control and exclusive use of the parking space.

rguard-new-line-am-acryl-antenna.title: RGuard New Line AM Acryl Antenna
rguard-new-line-am-acryl-antenna.description:
The RGuard New Line AM Acryl Antenna anti-theft system is a modern and effective loss prevention solution designed for retail environments, including supermarkets, clothing stores, and digital stores.

Innovative Design: It features an independent, new design and a slim/miniature body that saves valuable retail space in the store.

Advanced Technology: Equipped with high-performance DSP (Digital Signal Processing) chips, which ensure enhanced accuracy and virtually zero reduction in false alarms.

Debugging Function: It includes a debugging (diagnostics/troubleshooting) function via Wifi cloud & Mobile APP,allowing for remote monitoring and configuration.

rguard-new-line-rf-acryl-antenna.title: RGuard New Line RF Acryl Antenna
rguard-new-line-rf-acryl-antenna.description:
The RGuard New Line RF Acryl Antenna is a premium anti-theft system, ideal for luxury and specialty stores.

Design: Made from high-quality German organic glass, featuring an elegant and modern appearance.

Performance: Ensures high-efficiency detection and a low false alarm rate.

Key Advantage: Offers an ultra-wide detection distance, optimizing customer flow and entrance space.

Applications: Suitable for Supermarkets, clothing stores, digital stores, and other types of retail units.

scaner-bi-optic-datalogic-magellan-9550i.title: Datalogic Magellan 9550i Bi-optic Scanner
scaner-bi-optic-datalogic-magellan-9550i.description:
The Datalogic Magellan 9550i is a high-performance bi-optic (in-counter mounted) scanner designed as a smart and durable solution for high-volume retail stores, such as supermarkets and hypermarkets. This model offers an excellent balance between speed, efficiency, and value, making it an optimal choice for modernizing checkout operations.

Key Information and Advantages:

Peak Performance: It delivers an impressive 45% faster 2D code reading and better 1D performance compared to the previous generation. It can easily read damaged, truncated, or poor-quality barcodes.

Energy Efficiency (Sustainability): It is a sustainable solution, consuming less than 3 watts of power (2.57W in Eco Mode) —less power than a typical lightbulb. This contributes to reduced operational costs and meeting sustainability goals.

Future-Ready Technology: It supports the GS1 2D Digital Link standard out-of-the-box. This technology enables the simplification of multiple functions (such as product recalls or expiration date management) through a single 2D code.

Easy Integration: Due to its standard form factor, the scanner is a simple drop-in replacement for existing POS systems, allowing for a quick and seamless transition. It uses the same power supply, scale display, and interface cables as previous models.

Built for Demanding Environments: It is equipped with the All-Weighs platter design for weighing accuracy. It can be optionally equipped with an in-bonnet USB color camera that supports AI workflows (e.g., Produce Recognition) for loss prevention

hard-tag-antifurt-t003.title: Anti-theft Hard Tag (R-003)
hard-tag-antifurt-t003.description:
Hard Tag (R-003) is a small, rigid anti-theft tag designed for the protection of retail items, especially those in high-volume stores (clothing, accessories, textiles).

Its versatility is ensured by its availability in the two major article surveillance technologies:

RF (Radio Frequency): Operates at the standard frequency of 8.2MHz.

AM (Acousto-Magnetic): Operates at the standard frequency of 58kHz.

hard-tag-antifurt-t035.title: Anti-theft Hard Tag (R-035)
hard-tag-antifurt-t035.description:
This large, round, rigid tag is a robust and versatile EAS (Electronic Article Surveillance) security solution, designed to deter the theft of clothing and accessories from retail stores.

Essential Feature:

The R-035 tag is available for both main security technologies (RF and AM), ensuring compatibility with the anti-theft system installed in your store.

hard-tag-antifurt-t-067.title: Anti-theft Hard Tag (R-067)
hard-tag-antifurt-t-067.description:
This rigid tag is designed to offer an efficient and discreet security solution. Thanks to the AM frequency, it is ideal for retail environments with densely packed products, where AM (Acousto-Magnetic) systems provide a superior detection rate.

Essential Feature:

Although this model (R-067) is specifically configured for AM (58kHz), this type of tag design (possibly a mini-pencil or rectangular shape) is widely manufactured and is also available in the RF (8.2MHz) version to ensure compatibility with various EAS systems.

hard-tag-antifurt-t-047.title: Anti-theft Hard Tag (R-047)
hard-tag-antifurt-t-047.description:
This rigid tag, known as Super III (R-047), is a high-performance solution intended for retail environments that require an increased level of security.

Essential Feature:

It is a dual-frequency tag and is compatible with the Super Detacher system, offering superior protection against tampering/theft.

detachers-universal.title: Automatic barrier RParking PRO
detachers-universal.description:
Automatic barriers represent the perfect solution for modern, versatile, and highly convenient access control, and are increasingly in demand today. These high-performance systems seamlessly combine mechanical reliability with smart technology, making them the ideal choice for limiting and regulating access in parking areas, public spaces, hospitals, hotels, as well as industrial and private sites.

Key Features and Functions:

Superior Design and Premium Quality: The barrier base features an integrated digital panel with clear visual indicators, ensuring optimal visibility and an intuitive user experience.

Durable Motor: The motor is constructed from die-cast aluminum alloy, offering exceptional precision and excellent heat dissipation properties.

Advanced Operational Safety: The system is equipped with dual safety limit switches and an essential automatic reversal function of the boom upon detecting an obstacle, maximizing safety.

Supplementary Detection Systems: Optionally supports the installation of an infrared photocell for enhanced anti-shock protection.

optical-tag-antifurt-o-001.title: Optical Tag (RO-001)

The tag provides effective security for the product without in any way obstructing the customer's viewing or trying on of the item.

hard-tag-antifurt-t-048.title: Anti-theft Hard Tag (R-048)
hard-tag-antifurt-t-048.description: This rigid security tag was designed to offer a discreet and non-bulky solution, ideal for products that require subtle anti-theft protection. Thanks to its flat and square design, it integrates perfectly onto items without affecting their visibility or appearance.

hard-tag-antifurt-t047-1.title: Anti-theft Hard Tag (R-047-1)
hard-tag-antifurt-t047-1.description:
This rigid security tag represents a top-tier security solution, designed to ensure maximum protection for valuable items and those difficult to secure with standard methods.

Superior Security:

Super Lock Locking System: Equipped with a high-security locking mechanism, which offers increased resistance against forced removal attempts.

Versatile Cable Protection: Includes a Metal Cable (Lanyard), making it ideal for securing products that do not allow the use of a standard pin.

Ideal Applications: The tag is perfect for protecting premium items and those with an irregular shape, such as:

  • Bags and backpacks
  • Footwear
  • Tools or specialized equipment

Dual-Frequency Flexibility: Its essential feature is its dual-frequency nature, which guarantees maximum flexibility in any mixed retail environment. It can be integrated and detected by both major EAS systems.

bottle-tag-b-001.title: Bottle Tag (R-001)
bottle-tag-b-001.description:
The Bottle Tag security tag is the ideal solution for protecting items sold in bottles (such as spirits, wines, specialty oils, etc.). It is designed to provide robust security without affecting the product's visibility.

Dual and Multi-Frequency Compatibility: The tag supports operation on multiple frequencies, ensuring compatibility with most Electronic Article Surveillance (EAS) systems on the market.

bottle-cap-b-012.title: Bottle Cap (R-012)

Dual-Frequency Compatibility: The tag is compatible with both major Electronic Article Surveillance (EAS) systems.

bottle-cap-b-011.title: Bottle Cap (R-011)
bottle-cap-b-011.description:

This device is part of the anti-theft bottle tag family and introduces a new concept of protection: the locking mechanism is positioned inside the tag, thereby preventing potential thieves from cutting or forcing the tag. Furthermore, its design prevents the product from being opened directly inside the store.

bottle-cap-b-015.title: Bottle Cap (R-015)
bottle-cap-b-015.description:
Bottle Cap R-015 is a state-of-the-art anti-theft security solution, designed to efficiently protect almost all types of alcoholic beverage bottles in stores, including wines, champagne, and spirits bottles with narrow or wide necks.

This device uses a unique patented cap locking mechanism which not only secures the bottle but also prevents the product from being opened or consumed inside the store. Although it offers superior protection, the tag is easy to attachwith a simple twist and removed single-handedly using a conventional detacher at the point of sale.

spider-tag.title: Spider Tag
spider-tag.description: This device is a compact and efficient solution for protecting valuable and bulky items in stores, such as electronics, perfume boxes, or small appliances. It functions as an alarm system that triggers the sensors at the store entrance if the product has not been properly deactivated.

bottle-tag-b-002.title: Bottle Tag (R-002)
bottle-tag-b-002.description:
This device is a compact security tag, specially designed to protect bottles of alcoholic beverages or other similar products, preventing theft from stores.

Main Features:

  • Robust Protection: The tag is secured to the neck of the bottle using a resistant metal cable, which cannot be easily cut, thus ensuring a secure attachment.
  • Secure Locking System: It utilizes a magnetic locking mechanism that can only be quickly unlocked with a special magnetic detacher at the checkout counter, ensuring fast and efficient removal.

hard-tag-antifurt-t-006.title: Anti-Theft Hard Tag (R-006)
hard-tag-antifurt-t-006.description:
This compact rigid tag represents an extremely versatile and efficient security solution, designed to offer maximum protection for a wide range of products.

Essential Features and Versatility:

  • Protects textile articles by using the pin.
  • Secures products that cannot be perforated, such as bags or sports equipment, by using the metal cable (Lanyard).

Standard Locking System: Features a standard magnetic locking system (Magnetic Locking), ensuring easy integration into the existing workflow.

dr-roll-barcode.title: DR Roll Barcode
dr-roll-barcode.description:
This DR Roll Barcode Label is a soft label type solution, ideal for the quick and effective protection of products in stores equipped with EAS (Electronic Article Surveillance) security systems.

Discrete Design (Barcode Look): The barcode label appearance helps with discrete integration onto product packaging.

dr-sheet-barcoder.title: DR Sheet Barcoder
dr-sheet-barcoder.description:
This label is a soft tag, technically called a DR (Disposable Resonator), and represents a discreet and highly effective anti-theft security solution, ideal for direct application on products such as books, boxes, cosmetic packaging, and other items.

Key Features and Benefits:

  • Maximum Discretion: Being a soft tag, it easily integrates onto the product without affecting its aesthetic appearance.
  • Economical Format: The label is delivered as a DR Sheet Barcoder (on a sheet), facilitating quick and high-volume application.

rf-label-3030.title: RF Label 30*30
rf-label-3030.description:
This label is a type of soft label, model RF30*30, and represents a discreet and highly effective anti-theft security solution, ideal for application on various products. It is supplied on a roll, optimized for quick automatic or manual application processes.

Key Features and Benefits:

  • Compact and Discreet Format: With a square dimension of 30x30mm, the label is small enough to be discreetly applied to packaging without affecting brand visibility.
  • Versatile Material Options: It can be made from customized thermal paper, making it compatible with the printing of barcodes, lot numbers, or other variable information.
  • Superior Quality (Q-Factor): The Quality Factor Q≥60 indicates excellent detection performance.

rf-label-4040.title: RF Label 40*40
rf-label-4040.description:
This label is a type of soft label, model RF40*40, and represents a discreet and highly effective anti-theft security solution, ideal for application on various products. It is supplied on a roll, optimized for quick automatic or manual application processes.

Key Features and Benefits:

  • Standard Square Format: With a dimension of 40x40mm, it offers an optimal surface for performance while being compact enough for discreet application on packaging.
  • Superior Quality (Q-Factor): The Quality Factor Q≥80 indicates excellent performance and a superior detection range, ensuring a high level of security.
  • Versatile Printing Options: It can be made from customized thermal paper, making it compatible with the printing of barcodes, lot numbers, or other variable information.

detachers-d-001-d-002.title: Detacher (R-001/ R-002)
detachers-d-001-d-002.description:
The magnetic detacher, available under models R-001 / R-002, is an essential, compact, and efficient instrument, designed for the quick and safe removal of rigid security tags (hard tags) from retail products.

Its discreet and ergonomic design makes it ideal for strategic placement at the Point of Sale (POS), ensuring rapid unlocking and streamlining the checkout process.

Essential Feature: Dual Magnetic Force

The detacher is available in two magnetic strength variants to ensure maximum compatibility with various types of magnetic-lock security tags:

  • Normal: (4500−4700 GS)
  • Strong (Super Lock): (5500−6500 GS)

This flexibility allows users to choose the security level necessary for their tag collection.

detachers-d-003.title: Detacher (R-003)
detachers-d-003.description:
The Golf-type Magnetic Detacher (R-003) is a professional, high-power instrument, absolutely essential for the efficient and rapid removal of rigid security tags (hard tags) from retail stores.

Its design is distinctive, being similar to a cut golf ball, and this ergonomic shape, combined with extremely high magnetic force, makes it the ideal choice for managing the most secure anti-theft tags.

Essential Feature: Extreme Magnetic Power

Unlike standard detachers, the R-003 model is specially designed for high-security tags:

  • Suitable for: Tags with Super Lock or even Hyper Lock systems.
  • High Magnetic Force: It is available in two extremely high magnetic force variants, ensuring the unlocking of even the most secure tags:
  • 8000 GS
  • 11000 GS

detachers-model-d-005.title: Detacher (R-005)
detachers-model-d-005.description:
The UNIVERSAL Magnetic Detacher (R-005) is a professional, high-performance instrument, designed to offer the most comprehensive and powerful solution for unlocking rigid security tags (hard tags) in retail.

This model is capable of removing almost all types of rigid tags that use magnetic locking systems, including higher-level ones, such as Super Lock or Hyper Lock.

Essential Feature: The Most Powerful Detacher

The R-005 model is distinguished by its extreme magnetic power, being the most powerful detacher in the range:

  • Guaranteed Magnetic Force: It has a guaranteed magnetic force of minimum 11000 GS, making it the ultimate instrument for unlocking high-security tags

detachers-d-006.title: Detacher (R-006)
detachers-d-006.description:
This high-power magnetic detacher (R-006) is a professional instrument specially designed for the rapid and efficient removal of Pencil Tags and other rigid (hard) tags that use strong locking systems.

Essential Features:

  • High Security: It is available in two variants of high magnetic force: 8000 GS or 11000 GS, making it a high-security instrument capable of handling even the most resistant tags.
  • Discrete Design: Its Counter Sunk design allows for discrete and elegant integration at the point of sale (POS), minimizing the space occupied.
  • Robust Construction: The product is manufactured from a metallic material with a silver/metallic finish, ensuring durability and long-term use.

detacher-d-0018.title: Detacher (R-0018)
detacher-d-0018.description:
This high-power magnetic detacher (R-0018) is a professional instrument designed to offer enhanced security and increased durability, especially due to its robust plastic casing. It is the ideal solution for the rapid and safe removal of high-security rigid (hard) tags.

Key Features and Advantages:

  • Extreme Magnetic Force: It boasts a high magnetic force, ranging between 8000 GS and 12000 GS, which allows it to quickly and efficiently unlock even the most resistant security tags on the market.
  • Protective Design (Cap/Lid): It is equipped with a cap (Lid) that fulfills two essential functions:
  • Protects the magnet when not in use, maintaining its efficiency.
  • Masks the industrial appearance of the magnet, integrating much better aesthetically at the point of sale (POS).

detacher-d-021.title: Detacher (R-021)
detacher-d-021.description:
The STOP LOCK DETACHER is an essential instrument, specially designed for the removal of Stop Lock systems (also known as Peg Hook Locks).

This device is used in stores to unlock access to products displayed on peg hooks, thereby preventing direct theft from the shelf.

Key Features and Benefits:

  • Dedicated Tool: It is a specific instrument, optimized for the rapid unlocking of Stop Lock tags .
  • Standardized Magnetic Force: It uses a magnetic force of 5000 GS, which is sufficient to ensure efficient operation with Stop Lock systems.

detacher-d-007.title: Detacher (R-007)
detacher-d-007.description:
This Golf-type magnetic detacher is a professional instrument, similar to the R-003 model but with a slight difference in dimensions. It is a high-power instrument, essential for removing rigid security tags (hard tags) that use powerful locking systems (Super Lock, Hyper Lock).

Key Features:

  • Integrated Protection: It offers dual security: anti-theft (due to integrated EAS technology) and prevention of the bottle's content from being opened or replaced before purchase.
  • Secure Locking Mechanism: The tag firmly fixes around the bottle neck and requires a special magnetic detacher (similar to a standard rigid tag) to be removed at the point of sale.
  • Robust Construction: Composed of a black base and a transparent body.

These security caps are an effective solution for supermarkets and specialized stores selling alcoholic beverages or premium products.

tag-detacher-aed-001.title: TAG Detacher (AER-001)
tag-detacher-aed-001.description:
This electric detacher (Tag Power Detacher) represents a modern and efficient solution for deactivating security tags. Unlike passive magnetic detachers, this device uses electricity to generate the necessary field for tag deactivation, offering superior performance and extended versatility.

Essential Features and Advantages:

  • Dual-Frequency Detacher: This is a defining characteristic! The device is capable of simultaneously deactivating:
  • Rigid tags (AM)
  • Soft labels (RF)
  • This versatility makes it the ideal solution for stores that use both EAS (Electronic Article Surveillance) technologies, eliminating the need for two separate devices.
  • Active Electric Deactivation: By using electrical energy, it ensures consistent and reliable deactivation, reducing errors and improving the workflow at the point of sale.

tag-detacher-aed-002.title: TAG Detacher (AER-002)
tag-detacher-aed-002.description:
The AER-002 Detacher is an electric tag deactivation device, designed to offer an elegant, efficient, and most importantly, discrete security solution at the point of sale (POS). Being a version that mounts flush with the work surface, it ensures a tidy appearance and optimizes the workspace.

Key Features:

  • Dedicated AM Frequency (58 KHz): The device operates at the 58 KHz (Acousto-Magnetic) frequency, making it ideal for stores that use EAS (Electronic Article Surveillance) systems based on this technology.
  • Electric Deactivation: It uses electricity to generate the deactivation field, ensuring consistent and reliable performance in tag deactivation.

tag-detacher-aed-004.title: TAG Detacher (AER-004)
tag-detacher-aed-004.description:
This device is an electric deactivator (Deactivation Pad) of the desktop type and is used for the rapid and efficient deactivation of labels utilized in EAS (Electronic Article Surveillance) systems.

Essential Features and Design:

  • Ultra-Thin Design: Its reduced dimensions and flat, modern design allow for perfect integration either under the point of sale (POS) for maximum discretion, or directly on its surface.
  • Electric Deactivation: It uses electricity to generate an active deactivation field, guaranteeing constant, rapid, and reliable performance with every transaction.

tag-detacher-ah-001.title: TAG Detacher (AHR-001)
tag-detacher-ah-001.description:
This device (AHR-001) is a portable detacher (Hand Held), specially designed to offer maximum flexibility at the point of sale (POS) or directly in the warehouse. It is the ideal instrument for the rapid and efficient removal of rigid (hard) tags from products, without the need for a fixed surface.

Essential Feature: Super Lock Compatibility and Versatility

  • Portable Instrument (Hand Held): The ergonomic, pistol-grip design allows for one-handed operation and offers complete mobility. It is connected by a cable, ensuring constant accessibility and preventing device loss.
  • Super Lock Compatibility: Although it is specified with the 58 KHz (AM) frequency, this model is primarily designed to unlock Super Lock rigid tags.

Advantages and Benefits:

  • Maximum Flexibility: Allows for tag deactivation directly at the shelf or in hard-to-reach areas, improving operational efficiency.
  • Low Weight: With a weight of only 0.48 KG, it is easy to handle even during long working sessions.
  • Durable Construction: Made of resistant Plastic, it ensures long-term durability.

cosmetic-safer-s-023.title: Cosmetic Safer (RS-023)
cosmetic-safer-s-023.description:
This Cosmetic Safer is a rigid, transparent security box, specially designed for protecting high-value products, particularly cosmetics, perfumes, or other small items prone to theft. It combines full visibility of the product with robust EAS security.

Essential Features:

  • Dual-Frequency Safer: This is a Dual-Frequency Safer, being compatible with both major EAS systems: RF and AM.
  • Maximum Transparency: The transparent material (PC+ABS) ensures that the product inside is completely visible, while maintaining security.
  • Modern Locking System: It uses a locking system of the Magnetic Slide-Open type, which allows for rapid unlocking at the POS with the aid of an appropriate magnetic detacher.
  • Customizable Dimensions: Although the specified internal dimension is 102*125*70 mm, this type of safer is available in different sizes, adapted to customer request and specifications, to fit various products on the shelf.

cometic-safer-s-025.title: Cosmetic Safer (RS-025)
cometic-safer-s-025.description:
This Cosmetic Safer is a rigid, transparent, and larger-sized security solution, specially designed for the protection of medium-sized valuable items, such as cosmetics, perfumes, or other similar objects, in stores.

Key Features:

  • Excellent Visibility: The transparent design ensures full visibility of the product inside, allowing customers to examine it while keeping it secure.
  • Dual-Frequency Security (EAS): It is a latest-generation Dual-Frequency Safer, compatible with both major Electronic Article Surveillance (EAS) systems:
  • RF: 8.2MHz
  • AM: 58KHz
  • Secure Locking System: It uses a Magnetic Slide-Open Locking system for quick and secure access only by authorized personnel.

razor-safer-s-024.title: Razor Safer
razor-safer-s-024.description:
This Razor Safer is a rigid, transparent security box specially designed to protect razor blade packs, small electronic products, or other valuable items with a similar shape. The combination of full product visibility and robust EAS security makes it an essential tool in retail.

Key Features:

  • Dual-Frequency: Compatible with both major EAS systems (RF and AM), ensuring versatile protection.
  • Supported Frequencies: 8.2MHz (RF - Radio Frequency) and 58KHz (AM - Acousto-Magnetic).
  • Locking System: Slide-open Magnetic Locking for quick and secure operation by authorized personnel.
  • Durable Material: Constructed from PC+ABS, offering resistance and durability.

multifunction-safer.title: Multifunction Safer
multifunction-safer.description:
Are you looking for a robust and versatile security solution for bulky or irregularly shaped products? The Multifunction Safer is the answer!

This rigid, transparent, and large-sized security box is designed to protect a wide range of products, including:

  • Electronic accessories
  • Printer cartridges
  • Medications (Pharmaceuticals)
  • Video games
  • Hardware (Ferrous goods)

Key Features:

  • Safer Type: Dual-Frequency, compatible with both major EAS systems (RF and AM).
  • Supported Frequencies: 8.2MHz (RF) and 58KHz (AM).
  • Construction: Robust and transparent, made from high-quality PC+ABS material, ensuring optimal product visibility and maximum protection.
  • Locking System: Slide-open Magnetic Locking, for efficient security.

sistemul-antifurt-rguard-new-line-rf.title: RGuard New Line RF Security Gate System
sistemul-antifurt-rguard-new-line-rf.description:
The RGuard New Line RF security gate system is a powerful and reliable anti-theft device, designed to offer effective protection in retail environments where stability and anti-interference capability are essential.

Design

  • Manufactured from Aluminum Alloy, providing a durable structure and a modern appearance. Its functional design allows for efficient and visible integration at entry points.

Performance

  • Utilizes the standard frequency of 8.2MHz (RF), ensuring stable and consistent detection performance.
  • Features a strong anti-interference capability, making it ideal for environments with high electrical noise or near other electronic systems.
  • Operates in both Dual (two gates) and Mono (single gate) modes.

Applications

  • Suitable for Supermarkets, clothing stores, and other retail stores that require a robust and long-range security solution.

sistemul-antifurt-rguard-new-line-am.title: RGuard New Line AM Security Gate System
sistemul-antifurt-rguard-new-line-am.description:
The RGuard New Line AM anti-theft system is a high-performance security system designed to offer aesthetic and effective protection at wide store exits.

Performance and Technology

  • Technology: Utilizes Acoustomagnetic (AM) technology at a frequency of 58 kHz, recognized for its high detection rate.

Exceptional Coverage

  • Aisle Width: Protects wide aisles, with a passage width of up to 200 cm (2 meters) between pedestals.
  • Range: A single controller can support a total coverage of up to 8 meters.
  • Alarms: Provides audible and visual alarms for immediate notification of identified events.

Key Advantage: Metal Detection

  • False Alarm Reduction: When the system is installed with 2 pedestals, it can be supplemented with the AMC-7000 unit, which has the capability to distinguish metal foil from household metal objects (cell phones or packaged metal objects), preventing theft with foiled bags and reducing the risk of false alarms.

Other Features (Smart EAS Options)

  • People Counting: Includes people counting sensors integrated into the alarm lens, providing valuable data on customer flow.

terminal-de-intrare-cardpass-rparking.title: CardPass RParking Entry Terminal
terminal-de-intrare-cardpass-rparking.description:
Professional entry terminal for automated parking systems, made of galvanized steel resistant to outdoor conditions. Integrates a bright LCD screen with video display, automatic dispenser for issuing access cards, and 2D scanner compatible with mobile/paper codes.

Supports contactless RFID cards for subscriptions and badges, plus clear voice communication with the operator (with noise reduction). Includes internal controller, fan, and heating system for reliable operation in any conditions.

RParking Z601B barrier with integrated kit (green/red LED signaling), induction loop or other vehicle detection system, and video camera with automatic license plate recognition (LPR).

Easy configuration via web server, manual opening in case of power failure, IP54 protection. Complete and intelligent solution for commercial, residential, or institutional parking lots. Minimum 3-year warranty.

terminal-de-iesire-cardpass-rparking.title: CardPass RParking Exit Terminal
terminal-de-iesire-cardpass-rparking.description:
Professional exit terminal for automated parking systems, made of galvanized steel resistant to outdoor conditions. Integrates a bright LCD screen with video display, contactless RFID reader for subscription cards and badges, and 2D scanner for mobile/paper codes.

Ensures clear voice communication with the operator (with noise reduction) and reliable operation via internal controller, fan, and heating system.

RParking Z601B barrier with integrated kit (red/green LED signaling), induction loop or other vehicle detection system, and video camera with automatic LPR recognition.

Easy configuration via web server, manual opening in case of power failure, IP54 protection.

Fast and secure solution for exiting commercial, residential, or institutional parking lots.

terminal-de-iesire-ticket-system.title: Ticket System Exit Terminal
terminal-de-iesire-ticket-system.description:
Professional exit terminal for automated parking systems, made of galvanized steel resistant to outdoor conditions. Integrates a bright LCD screen with video display and 2D scanner for fast reading of barcodes from mobile devices or paper (tickets, mobile apps).

Supports clear voice communication with the operator (with noise reduction). Includes internal controller, fan, and heating system for reliable operation in any conditions. Ideal for commercial, residential, or institutional parking lots.

RParking Z601B barrier with integrated kit (red/green LED signaling) and induction loop or other vehicle detection system;

Video camera with vehicle license plate recognition function.

terminal-de-plata-generatia-2.title: Generation 2 Payment Terminal
terminal-de-plata-generatia-2.description:
Robust and autonomous payment terminal, with a 4 mm galvanized steel housing, designed for outdoor use and equipped with an internal door for the cash safe. Offers double anti-theft protection through vandal-resistant locks and reinforced safe-type body.

Includes RTI 5000 INB fiscal printer with online MEV transmission, 2D scanner for tickets, cards or phone codes (ready for mobile apps), and 19" PCAP anti-vandal touchscreen.

Accepts any payment: banknotes, coins, bank cards – with automatic change in cash and coins. Support call system with button, microphone, speakers (optional video camera).

Runs on a stable, remotely configurable Linux controller. Optional: Mia app integration, card dispenser and UPS.

Ideal for high-traffic parking lots – secure, user-friendly, 24/7 operation without on-site staff.

horeca-kiosk.title: HORECA KIOSK
horeca-kiosk.description:
HORECA KIOSK is an elegant self-service terminal designed for restaurants, hotels, and cafés. Featuring a 27-inch touchscreen, a modern black design, and a stable metal stand, it provides customers with an intuitive and seamless experience.

Powered by a modern processor, it delivers fast and reliable performance. The terminal integrates a built-in bank module for contactless payments, a 2D scanner, and an RTI 5000F fiscal printer, making it ideal for fully automated order and payment operations.

Perfect for digitalizing HORECA services and enhancing the customer experience.

retail-kiosk.title: RETAIL KIOSK
retail-kiosk.description:
RETAIL KIOSK is a modern, self-service terminal designed for the retail environment and points of sale. Featuring a 27-inch touchscreen and a sleek black design, it offers a fast and intuitive experience for customers.

Equipped with an 8 GB RAM processor and a 128 GB SSD, it ensures stable and reliable performance. The terminal includes a fixed 2D/QR scanner, an RTI 5000F fiscal printer, and a side bracket for a POS banking terminal, facilitating payment operations and receipt issuance.

The integrated light indicator signals the operational status, while the black metal stand provides stability and a professional look.

Ideal for retailers looking to improve efficiency and customer experience.

rprinter-421-l.title: RPrinter 421 L
rprinter-421-l.description: This compact thermal printer is a fast labeling solution that eliminates the need for ribbons using Direct Thermal technology. Its versatile design supports various media types, such as gap or perforated labels , making it easy to integrate into any workspace due to its small dimensions. The device ensures broad compatibility with most desktop and mobile operating systems , offering flexible connectivity through multiple interfaces

horeca-kiosk-white.title: HORECA KIOSK white
horeca-kiosk-white.description:
HORECA KIOSK is an elegant self-service terminal designed for restaurants, hotels, and cafés. Featuring a 27-inch touchscreen, a modern black design, and a stable metal stand, it provides customers with an intuitive and seamless experience.

Powered by a modern processor, it delivers fast and reliable performance. The terminal integrates a built-in bank module for contactless payments, a 2D scanner, and an RTI 5000F fiscal printer, making it ideal for fully automated order and payment operations.

Perfect for digitalizing HORECA services and enhancing the customer experience.

rsistems-folding-stand-pos.title: RSistems Folding Stand POS
rsistems-folding-stand-pos.description: This all-in-one POS with a touchscreen is ideal for retail and HoReCa, offering a compact and professional design. The metal casing and adjustable stand ensure stability and durability, while the system allows free installation of the desired software.

statie-intercom.title: Intercom station
statie-intercom.description:
Intercom station OEU-201S-HMK-W is a terminal device of a digital building intercom system, featuring video intercom, security alarm, and video surveillance functions to provide a safe and comfortable living environment. It is suitable for villa and residential housing systems.

Features:

  • Front panel: aluminum alloy
  • Supports batch configuration
  • Supports calling and intercom with connected indoor stations and mobile app
  • Supports monitoring, security alarm, and tamper alarm functions
  • Supports Wi-Fi
  • Built-in IC card reader
